stories.title: The benefits of AI in health care outweigh potential hazards, many experts say
stories.summary: ChatGPT Health is OpenAI's foray into medicine, and so far, it gets high marks from both a cancer patient and a leading doctor. But there are worries it could be misused.

stories.title: The World Economic Forum opens amid tensions between Europe and the U.S.
stories.summary: Tension is high as the World Economic Forum in Davos opens and President Trump threatens Europe over Greenland.

stories.title: Cows use tools too
stories.summary: Austrian researchers say they've found the first known example of tool use by cattle, courtesy of a Swiss-Brown cow named Veronika.

stories.title: Many homeless encampments have been cleared, but advocates say that's not a solution
stories.summary: Homeless encampment sweeps have been increasing since a pivotal Supreme Court decision in 2024. But medical experts and advocates for unhoused people say those sweeps have hidden health costs.

stories.title: An LA couple helps other musicians who, like them, lost gear in the fires
stories.summary: Brandon Jay and his wife, Gwendolyn Sanford, created Altadena Musicians to help those who may have lost their beloved musical instruments in last year's LA wildfires.

stories.title: A civil rights museum in Atlanta now includes exhibits from the Reconstruction era
stories.summary: A civil rights museum in Atlanta expanded recently and now includes the era of reconstruction that followed the Civil War and ultimately led to segregationist Jim Crow Laws in the South.
